message.content: {"caption":"A schematic of two agents evolving through tool-assisted reasoning, alongside four benchmark bar charts comparing model performance.","description":"The figure combines a two-agent process diagram on the left with four bar charts on the right. In the diagram, the Curriculum Agent is on the left and the Executor Agent is on the right. Three curriculum-agent characters and their task boards are arranged vertically, with a blue downward arrow linking the stages. On the executor side, agent characters are arranged vertically with green downward arrows; the middle stage shows an agent at a workbench labeled “Tool.” At the top, a blue rightward arrow points toward a box labeled “Question” containing q. A blue curved arrow arcs toward the Executor Agent, and a green curved arrow returns left toward the Curriculum Agent, indicating a cycle. In the center, a rounded box labeled “Reasoning Process” contains repeated sequences of blue, green, and orange blocks, with a vertical ellipsis between the rows. The legend identifies these blocks as “Model Response” (blue), “Tool Calling” (green), and “Tool Response” (orange). Arrows connect the blocks with a globe labeled “Environment”; tool calls go outward toward the environment/tool, and tool responses return into the reasoning process. A blue downward arrow leads from the process to a box containing â, labeled “Predicted Answer.” From there, a blue arrow points down-left to a gift icon labeled “Curriculum Reward” and r_C, while a green arrow points down-right to a gift icon labeled “Executor Reward” and r_E.\n\nThe four charts each compare Qwen3-8B, w/ tools, and Agent0, with the printed values shown above the bars. MATH: 78.0, 79.2, and 82.4, respectively. SuperGPQA: 28.3, 29.4, and 33.0. MMLU-Pro: 51.8, 54.8, and 63.4. BBEH: 8.6, 9.4, and 13.7. Thus Agent0 has the highest bar in each benchmark, and w/ tools is higher than Qwen3-8B in each.
